seasonalityNotes: Central Vietnam is driest and sunniest from February to August; September to December is the wet season, with October and November carrying the highest rain and storm risk.
gettingAround: Da Nang (DAD) is about 3 km from the riverfront; taxis and Grab reach My Khe Beach in 15–25 minutes, and Hoi An is roughly 45 minutes by road.

promotion.title: LotuStudents — up to 10% off connecting itineraries
promotion.summary: Verified students aged 15–31 can receive up to 10% off Premium Economy Classic, Economy Classic and Economy Lite fares on international itineraries connecting in Vietnam. Registration, document verification and peak-period exclusions apply.
